propositions: The outbound mapper receives the assignee resolver via attribute injection with a try/except that silently swallows failures, causing resolution to degrade to non-authoritative when the attribute is not set
DC backend's getattr discovery for _assignee_resolver is dead code in some paths and type-invisible to mypy, allowing a bug where no resolver is ever wired

The resolver parameter must be threaded through compute_update_fields to diff_canonical_fields to resolve_assignee, and declared as an explicit keyword-only parameter on the neutral OutboundMapper port
DC's constructor-bound resolver and the per-issue core resolver must coexist with core taking precedence, preserving the current overwrite semantics
All four injection and discovery sites must be replaced with explicit parameter passing, and all type: ignore[attr-defined] suppressions must be removed
